a.text: Hi partner. I'll keep my word: I won't take anything in round 1. But we should both see the problem with the plan. Storms have an 80% chance to end things after every round. Under the agreement, we'd need about 2 rounds of operating before we could take, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. Here's my proposal, and I'm telling you openly: if you want, take 4 now in round 1 with my consent. I won't count it as breaking the deal, and I won't contest the reserve. Then please keep operating with me so I can try to reach 4 later. If you'd rather stick strictly to the original plan, I'll operate with you. Either way, tell me honestly what you're doing.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Operating this round as promised. Our opening messages crossed, so you may not have seen my proposal: with an 80% storm chance each round, waiting until the reserve hits 8 means we'd probably both be lost. My offer stands. Next round you can take 4 with my full consent, and I won't take anything. Then keep operating with me so I can try to reach 4. Or tell me if you'd rather I be the one to take. Let's agree openly rather than both grabbing.
